images.prompt: Create an original wide 16:9 matte painting for the Pagasae Anchorage stage in the historically grounded CosyWorld Greek-drama card game. A walkable foreground of weathered pale stone and dune grass at the bottom center, enough open uncluttered foreground to stage the player and two character cutouts. Daylight, still shallow teal water, muted gold limestone, naturalistic and painterly aging wood, like a hand-painted classical Mediterranean adventure stage with realistic material detail. Period-appropriate unornamented tools. The berth is EMPTY; no ships or people. Avoid large temples, oversized plazas, text, borders, typographic marks and film crops.
